issues.description: Duplicate method signature — compile error. `public void feedAudio(UUID, short[], double[])` on line 57 and `private void feedAudio(UUID, short[], double[])` on line 65 have the same parameter types. Java does not allow two methods with the same name and parameter types regardless of access modifier. The code will not compile. Fix: Remove the public 3-arg overload (lines 57-59) and make the private 3-arg version public instead, since it already holds the lock and handles position internally. Then update the 2-arg overload to delegate to the public 3-arg via `feedAudio(playerId, audio48k, null)`.

summary: The data race from iteration 1 is fixed (playerPositions.put is now inside the lock). However, the refactoring introduced a Java compile-time error: two methods with identical signature `feedAudio(UUID, short[], double[])` cannot coexist. Fix by removing the public 3-arg overload and making the private 3-arg version public.
